blocks.label: Duplicate supplier invoice check
blocks.code:
-- One supplier invoice number, entered more than once.
-- The description is no longer compared: "June" and "Jun" got past it.
select supplier_id,
       supplier_invoice_number,
       count(*)          as entries,
       sum(gross_amount) as gross_total
from supplier_invoices
group by supplier_id, supplier_invoice_number
having count(*) > 1;
